articles.title: Five Ambitions Worth a Lifetime
articles.description: Five ambitious directions for a lifetime of work: longer healthy lives, freedom from poverty, interstellar science, deeper self-awareness, and abundant clean energy.
articles.aside_copy: Time. Agency. Capacity. Judgment. Horizon. Five directions for a lifetime of work.
